import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()

# Check the latest error log
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /var/log/areloria/error-*.log | tail -3")

print(stdout.read().decode())

# Get the most recent
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -30 /var/log/areloria/error-0.log")
print("\n=== Latest error log ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
PYEOF
